I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer, and beans grow well enough without it because they fix nitrogen in the soil. I will put manure on the plot because my household keeps a few goats and chickens, so we have some dung available. I will plant the bean seed I saved from last season since I cannot afford to buy new seed from the shop, and I will pull weeds by hand rather than buying expensive sprays. We will work this plot ourselves as a family because hiring labor is too costly for a small rented field.
